result.document_summary: A Berkeley Rent Stabilization Board guide table showing which unit and tenancy types are covered by Berkeley's rent control, just cause for eviction, and security deposit interest provisions.
result.notes: The document is a coverage guide table with no ordinance section numbers or numeric caps. It states which categories apply (rent control and just cause for eviction) and by unit type, but gives no effective dates. Citation uses the ordinance name given in the title; Berkeley Municipal Code ch. 13.76 is not named in the text, so it is not cited. A 'Fully Covered' building-age test of 'before 1980' conflicts slightly with 'Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980' for new construction (gap for units occupied between Jan 1 and June 1980), so confidence is reduced. Security deposit interest is mentioned only as a coverage flag, with no rule details, so no security_deposits record was produced.

rules.title: Berkeley Rent Stabilization Ordinance coverage (rent control)
rules.requirement: Rent control under Berkeley's Rent Stabilization Ordinance applies to fully covered units, mainly multifamily properties built before 1980, single-family homes whose current tenancy began before 1996, and rooming houses. New construction, post-1995 single-family tenancies, most condominiums and certain subsidized units are registered but not subject to rent control.

rules.exemptions_text: Exempt from all provisions: Golden Duplex, owner-shared kitchen or bath, ADU properties with owner occupancy (tenancies after Nov 7, 2018), university units, nonprofit cooperatives. Partially covered (registration, just cause and deposit interest but no rent control): post-June 1980 new construction, single-family tenancies beginning on or after Jan 1, 1996, most condominiums, and certain HUD-subsidized units.

rules.title: Berkeley Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance coverage
rules.requirement: Just cause for eviction applies to both fully covered and partially covered units (including new construction, post-1995 single-family tenancies, most condominiums and certain subsidized units). Only the listed exempt categories are outside just cause protections.
